about_the_game:
In this roguelike tower defense strategy game, you'll build labyrinths to defend your shrines from lurking evil. Every maze is a tactical puzzle—discover leylines that supercharge your towers, bogs to mire down your enemies, and heavy fog that turns the battle map into a mystery. With some help from the ancient gods of Ireland, you can mix and match divine boons among your towers to obliterate enemies with devastating combos.

Features multiplayer co-op with up to 4 people, with collaborative planning tools so you and your friends can argue about maze layouts in real time.

(We're still hand-making assets daily, so screenshots are a work in progress. You're catching us early—we appreciate the curiosity!)

CONTROL THE BATTLEFIELD!

Send enemies into bogs, chop down trees, and create new paths to build the most diabolical maze possible.

BUILD DEVASTATING COMBOS!

Combine 50+ abilities across 30+ towers using 30+ artifacts. Discover unique synergies with critical strikes, attack speed, high damage, special statuses, and more!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS!

Shrouded Siege was designed for up to 4 players with collaborative tools to plan your mazes, coordinate builds, and buff each other’s towers.

MASTER THE TERRAIN!

30+ handcrafted maps are randomized slightly each run to keep them familiar but fresh. Bogs, forests, lava, cliffs, stone, sand, and more affect towers and enemies alike, with special tiles that mix things up even further for endless replayability.

 

The demo includes two of five playable characters. The second campaign, boss battle, signature endgame towers, and additional maps are available in the full game.

short_description: Lure enemies through traps and defend your shrines in this maze-building roguelike tower defense—play solo or with 4 players in co-op. Set in Irish mythology, each campaign brings endless upgrades to combine and randomized tactical challenges that keep every run a new maze to master.
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal
